evidence: Initializes the caller output to UINT32_MAX and returns with that sentinel unless bit 28 of the loaded global word is set. On the active path, derives a context selector from global data and resolves an object through f_700181a6bc; if its +8 pointer is null, it calls f_700183f6e4. It then requests nested selector 0x1b through nested_attribute_provider_get_float, converts the returned float to signed 32-bit integer, and stores it through the output pointer. The resolver input field and fallback helper meaning remain unresolved. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:49542-49568; resolver decompiled/main/main_0169.c:28227-28239; provider accessor decompiled/main/main_0170.c:13026-13035.

Initializes the caller output to UINT32_MAX and returns with that sentinel when bit 28 of the loaded global word is clear. On the active path, calls f_7000d1cd78 and f_7000205b74, resolves the resulting attribute object through f_700181a6bc using global root 0x7004650000+0x998, and calls f_700183f6e4 if the resolved +8 pointer is null. It then calls accepted player_attribute_get_float with selector 0x4c, converts the result to signed 32-bit integer, and stores it through the output pointer. The preliminary helper semantics remain unresolved. decompiled/main/main_0125.c:2487-2514; object resolver decompiled/main/main_0169.c:28227-28239; attribute getter decompiled/main/main_0170.c:12861-12889 (callee 0x700183e8e0).

Initializes the caller output to UINT32_MAX and returns with that sentinel when bit 26 of the loaded global word is set. Otherwise loads a selector value from the global context record, resolves an attribute object through f_700181a6bc using global slot 0x700227d000+0xda0, and calls f_700183f6e4 if the resolved +8 pointer is null. It then calls accepted player_attribute_get_float with the loaded selector, converts the result to signed 32-bit integer, and stores it to the caller output. The selector value and context fields are not assigned a source type. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:23712-23738; resolver decompiled/main/main_0169.c:28227-28239.

Returns -2 for a null input pointer. Otherwise calls convert_attribute_value_to_float_div_100 on the input, then compares the resulting float with 0.7, 0.8, and 0.9. The output code is 0 below 0.7, 3 for [0.7,0.8), 1 for [0.8,0.9), and 2 at or above 0.9. decompiled/main/main_0094.c:6782-6811; conversion helper decompiled/main/main_0171.c:9259-9272.

Calls f_70005398c0 with a fixed argument and returns 0 if the helper result bit 0 is set. Otherwise queries accepted attribute_context_status_value_get with selector 0x13, checks whether the returned low byte equals 4, and reads global byte 0x7003ae8731. Returns 2 only when the helper bit is clear, the selector-0x13 low byte is 4, and the global byte is nonzero; all other paths return 0. decompiled/main/main_0088.c:30645-30667; status getter decompiled/main/main_0169.c:41216-41274.
